name: Azure Reef
description: The rubble of the Azure Window, the famous arch at Dwejra that collapsed in a storm in March 2017. Huge boulders from just below the surface to past 40 m, still mostly bare rock with algae and fish slowly moving in, and swim-throughs between the blocks. Usually entered through the Blue Hole and combined with Coral Gardens.
conditions: The boulders can still shift; take care in the swim-throughs.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
